info.title: OpenChat Installation API
info.description: REST contract for the dashboard, mobile app, and widget.

email.description: Never verified, so it proves nothing about who this is.

RealtimeTicket.description: Connect to `url` within 30 seconds. The ticket is good for one purpose only, and grants nothing over REST.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Present when this website requires Turnstile for a new visitor.

messageMaxChars.description: The longest message this installation accepts from a visitor. A longer one is refused with `message_too_long`.

agentReadSeq.description: How far any agent has read, as a public sequence number.

VisitorConversation.description: A deliberately reduced view, with no assignee, priority, or internal counters.

VisitorConversationStarted.description: The conversation, and the message that started it, so that a client knows it is committed without asking again.

contactEmail.description: Given by the visitor or an agent. Never verified.

lastReadSeq.description: The caller's read position, for unread counts.

relay.description: Compared by the app with its build-time allowlist, and read by the relay to prove domain control.

refreshToken.description: Mobile only. Dashboard clients receive an HttpOnly cookie instead.

websiteKey.description: Public identifier embedded in page source. Not a credential.

state.description: not_configured: no relay in this deployment. disconnected: an admin disconnected from the configured relay, which erased what it held, and push is off.

subscriptions.description: Phones registered for push, across every workspace.

get.summary: Get a contact

patch.summary: Correct a name, email, or phone number

get.summary: The workspace's tags, by name

post.summary: Create a tag, or return the one with this name

200.description: A tag with this name already exists, whatever its capitals.

delete.summary: Delete a tag, and take it off everything

put.summary: Replace the tags on a conversation
put.description: Does not move the conversation's version, so tagging never conflicts with a reply or an assignment. The last write wins.

post.summary: A ticket for a socket that receives everything in this workspace
A ticket for a socket that receives this conversation's public events

get.summary: Upgrade to a WebSocket
get.description: Frames are published as AgentServerFrame, AgentClientFrame, VisitorServerFrame, and VisitorClientFrame.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived, single-use grant for the device to present to the relay

get.summary: The caller's registered devices

post.summary: Store the opaque handle returned by the relay. No device token is sent here.

delete.summary: Remove a device, and unregister it at the relay

get.summary: The caller's preferences. An event with no choice made is on.
A page that asks to confirm
get.description: Changes nothing, because mail scanners open links on their own. No sign-in. The token in the link is the only authority.

post.summary: Unsubscribe, from the page or by one click in a mail app (RFC 8058)
post.description: Adds the address to the workspace suppression list and clears its consent. Repeating it changes nothing more.

get.summary: Addresses this workspace must not email. For supervisors.

post.summary: Add an address by hand. For supervisors.
Remove an address added by hand. For supervisors.
post.description: Refuses with 409 for anyone who unsubscribed, whose bounce or complaint is on record.

get.summary: Rules for following up on quiet conversations. For supervisors.

post.summary: Add a rule. For supervisors.
post.description: A rule only ever emails an open conversation whose visitor gave an address and consent. It first applies after the next public message in a conversation.

get.summary: Public configuration. Cached for 30 seconds. The Origin must be allowed for the website.

post.summary: Create or resume an anonymous visitor session. The Origin must be allowed for the website.
post.description: A refresh token that is unknown or belongs to another website starts a new visitor, with no history.

turnstileToken.description: Needed to start a new visitor on a website that requires Turnstile. Not needed to resume one.

patch.summary: Provide a name, email, and follow-up consent
patch.description: An email is unverified, and never merges with an existing contact automatically.

get.summary: The visitor's own conversations

post.summary: Start a conversation with a first message

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId. Returns the same conversation.

post.summary: Upload a file
post.description: The body is the file, as a stream, with its type in Content-Type and its size in Content-Length. Name its ID on a later message. A file that no message claims within a day is deleted.

get.summary: Download a file

post.summary: Upload a file to a conversation of this visitor
post.description: The body is the file, as a stream, with its type in Content-Type and its size in Content-Length. Name its ID on a later message. A file that no message claims within a day is deleted.

get.summary: Download a file on a public message in a conversation of this visitor
Public messages only, oldest first. Here seq is the public sequence.

post.summary: Send a message. Rate limited per visitor and per website.

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId

post.summary: Move the visitor's delivered and read positions forward, in public sequence numbers

get.summary: An inbox view, most recent first

schema.description: A `syncCursor` from an earlier response. Returns everything changed since, in any status, oldest change first. Other filters are ignored.

parameters.description: A `syncCursor` from an earlier response. Returns everything changed since, in any status, oldest change first. Other filters are ignored.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

syncCursor.description: Pass as `updatedAfter` to catch up later.

get.summary: Get a conversation

patch.summary: Assign, transfer, resolve, reopen, archive, or reprioritise
patch.description: Compare-and-set on `expectedVersion`. A stale version answers 409 with the current version.

get.summary: Messages, including internal notes, oldest first

schema.description: Forward from this sequence number, for catch-up.

parameters.description: Forward from this sequence number, for catch-up.
parameters.name: afterSeq

schema.description: Backward from this sequence number, for history.

parameters.description: Backward from this sequence number, for history.
parameters.name: beforeSeq

post.summary: Send a reply or an internal note

attachmentIds.description: Files uploaded to this conversation by this member. Content may be empty if there is at least one.

200.description: A replay of an existing clientMessageId. Returns the original.

post.summary: Move the caller's delivered and read positions forward

get.summary: Liveness only. Exposes no configuration.
Describe this installation and its compatibility

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Rotate a refresh token. Reuse of an old token revokes the session.
Revoke the current session
Always returns 202, whether or not the account exists
Set a new password. Revokes all sessions for the user.
Confirm an email address

get.summary: The current user and their workspace memberships
List every account on the installation. Anyone but an installation admin gets 404.

post.summary: Create an account and email a link that lasts seven days to choose a password. 409 if the address has an account.

patch.summary: Grant or take away installation admin. The installation must keep one active admin.

post.summary: End all access, keeping the account and its memberships. Refused for yourself.
Restore a deactivated account, with its password and memberships as they were.

put.summary: Put someone in a workspace with a role, or change their role there. Brings back a removed or suspended member. An admin who adds themselves can then read the workspace, and this is audited.

delete.summary: Remove someone from a workspace. Their messages keep their name.

get.summary: List every workspace by name. Gives no access to its conversations.

post.summary: Create a workspace. Nobody joins it by creating it, so assign people to it afterwards.

get.summary: List the websites of any workspace, without being a member of it

post.summary: Register a website and obtain its public key

get.summary: Get a workspace
List members. People are changed by an installation admin, under /api/v1/admin.
List websites. They are changed by an installation admin, under /api/v1/admin.
The notification relay this installation uses, and whether push is on

post.summary: Turn push off, and have the relay erase everything it holds about this installation. Push stays off until reconnected.
post.description: Repeat it if it answers 503: push is already off, and only the erasure at the relay is left.

200.description: Disconnected, and erased at the relay

post.summary: Turn push back on. Phones register again the next time the app starts.
